merge_scope: DERIVATIVE_APPLICATIONS only; preserve all non-derivative canonical records

merge_strategy.topics: upsert staging derivative topics by code; preserve all other canonical topics
merge_strategy.problem_types: upsert staging derivative problem types by code; preserve other chapters; retain legacy COMPLETE_FUNCTION_ANALYSIS as compatibility record with is_active=false
merge_strategy.concepts: union canonical concepts and detailed derivative staging concepts by code; staging wins on exact code overlap
merge_strategy.learning_outcomes: union canonical broad outcomes and M12_DERIV_LO_01..10; no destructive deletion
merge_strategy.concept_relations: set-union by (source_code,target_code,relation_type); staging wins exact duplicate
merge_strategy.problem_type_concepts: upsert by (problem_type_code,concept_code); staging wins exact overlap
merge_strategy.problem_type_learning_outcomes: upsert by (problem_type_code,learning_outcome_code); staging wins exact overlap

review_boundaries: Do not set canonical root manifest verified_at.
Do not overwrite canonical root files in this phase.
Candidate files must not be discoverable as an importable manifest by CurriculumImportService.
Official learning outcomes remain source-backed; derived topics/problem types/concepts/weights/difficulty remain Coach Learning derived.
Human/domain review remains required before canonical root promotion.
